d: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav reviewed the newly launched PAVAN Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC), highlighting its single-window digital monitoring system for air quality, emissions, meteorology, and compliance across Delhi-NCR. Emphasising a whole-of-government approach uniting multiple central ministries and state governments, he congratulated the commission and partner agencies for developing this platform to track pollution hotspots via nodal officers.
